results.name: Ethan's first season: podium placings at ICN SA
results.caption: Ethan, ICN SA 2026
results.alt: Ethan on stage at ICN South Australia in posing trunks, wearing a medal
results.summary:
Ethan prepped for 22 weeks, with the plan adapted around a chaotic schedule, peak week included.

At ICN South Australia he won Men's Physique First Timer, came 2nd in Novice and 3rd in Classic Physique.

testimonial.quote: I truly appreciate the support and understanding you showed to adapt prep to my chaotic lifestyle, especially during peak week.
testimonial.author: Ethan

results.name: Rachel won two overall titles at one show

results.summary: Rachel won the overall title in Wellness and the overall title in Sports, both at the ICN South Australia state show. In her words, she was just doing her thing and having a blast.

testimonial.quote: Just doing my thing and having a blast while doing it.
testimonial.author: Rachel

results.name: Maxine won the overall state title in her debut
results.caption: Maxine, Miss Bikini State Champion
results.alt: Maxine on stage at ICN South Australia in a purple bikini and Ms Bikini sash, resting a hand on a ceremonial sword
results.summary:
At the very start, Maxine told Jake she'd do whatever it took to win that title.

Her first time on a bodybuilding stage, at ICN South Australia in 2025, ended with the overall Miss Bikini State title. It qualified her for Nationals and the pro league.

testimonial.quote: At the very start, I told my coach, "I'll do whatever it takes to win that title." And boy we did!
testimonial.author: Maxine

results.name: Jade won Bikini and her pro card at FMG Worlds
results.caption: Jade, FMG pro card
results.alt: Jade in a red bikini holding a plaque, standing with Jake, who holds a bunch of flowers
results.summary: Two weeks after placing 3rd at FMG New Zealand, Jade won Bikini at the FMG World Championships on the Gold Coast and was awarded her pro card.

testimonial.quote: The push you give has made me overcome so many limiting beliefs and showed me I actually can push harder and go further than I thought.
testimonial.author: Jade
